bio: This long-established family-run business serves up traditional Georgian cuisine. Specialities such as khinkali (dumplings filled with minced beef and pork) may seem simple at first glance, but there is more to them than meets the eye: wonderful textures, balanced flavours and harmonious seasoning. Let the cordial and attentive team guide you on how to get the most out of each dish – with the right technique, a truly comprehensive Georgian dining experience is guaranteed. These à la carte plates are ideal for sharing. Tip: Order a Georgian amber wine (orange wine) to accompany your food. The feast is to be savoured in a pleasant, cosy atmosphere, in an interior with lovely authentic decorative touches such as nostalgic photos and traditional accessories.
